title: ARPAPED Capability Catalog Record
description: One line of a generated capability catalog: one implementation, flattened from its manifest and contract. Read by both an agent doing Phase 3 -- Discover (grepped, before any code runs) and the runtime bootstrap, instead of either walking and re-parsing capabilities/ directly. Built and consumed by the resolved assembler (bridge/MANIFEST.yaml) -- see 2-RULES.md 'The Registry contract' and 1-CYCLE.md Phase 3.

implementation_id.description: Globally unique id of this implementation.

executor_path.description: For executor_kind 'direct'/'factory': a module:attr reference (always a string), imported lazily by the runtime loader — never eagerly by the catalog itself. For executor_kind 'process': a program name or argv list, spawned lazily by the runtime loader instead of imported.

priority.description: Higher number = higher precedence = selected first among candidates that already match a request's other constraints. No default — see schemas/capability-manifest.schema.json and 2-RULES.md 'The Registry contract'.

domain.description: The contract's identity.domain — empty when the implementation was registered without a root to resolve the contract against; still fully discoverable at Exact/Scoped, invisible to Family/Domain/Cross-domain.

family.description: The contract's identity.family — only meaningful together with domain.

tags.description: The contract's discoverability.tags — the Cross-domain cascade level.

dependencies.description: The contract's dependencies.capabilities (R4), flattened to {capability_id: contract_version}: capability ids this implementation may call, live, through the Bridge, when executor_kind is 'factory', each pinned to the version constraint the contract actually declared (bare-string dependencies become "*"). Enforced at runtime by the resolved Bridge (bridge/MANIFEST.yaml): resolving an undeclared capability_id raises, and the declared constraint is always what gets resolved — never a value the factory can choose.

executor_kind.description: 'direct' (default): executor_path IS the executor. 'factory': executor_path is invoked once with a Dependencies scoped to `dependencies`, and its return value becomes the executor. 'process': executor_path names a program, spawned once, that becomes the executor -- for a capability implemented in a language other than the resolved Bridge's own.

description.description: This implementation's own operations, as described under its specific contract_version in the contract's `versions` (falling back to the contract-wide responsibility.description if unavailable) -- carried here purely for agent keyword search (Phase 3 -- Discover). Never consumed by the runtime loader.

default.description: Present only when this field declares one (schemas/component-contract.schema.json) -- its key's presence, not its value, is what signals 'has a default'; a field defaulting to null still carries this key.

input_schema.description: Each declared operation's input field shape, from the contract's specific contract_version (schemas/component-contract.schema.json), keyed by operation name. Consumed by the resolved Bridge (bridge/MANIFEST.yaml) to validate a request's input before any executor runs, in any language -- required fields present, and a present field's runtime value matches its declared type. Fields not declared here are never rejected.

manifest_path.description: Repo-relative path to the source manifest, for provenance/debugging only — not consumed at load time.

contract_path.description: As declared in the manifest, for provenance/debugging only.

executor_path.description: module:attr, required for executor_kind 'direct' (the default) and 'factory'.
